address: King William Walk, Greenwich Peninsula, London,SE10 9NF
bio: Built in 1869 for the China tea trade, Cutty Sark is a historic clipper ship that was designed to transport the freshest and finest teas to London. As the only surviving tea clipper in the world, this magnificent sailing ship is a real must-see attraction in Greenwich.  Climb aboard and explore this famous ship. Learn of its rich and fascinating history with entry for two. After a walk on the main deck, take a seat under the copper hull and indulge in a mouth-watering afternoon tea for two.  Enjoy a selection of sandwiches, sweet bites and scones with Devon clotted cream and strawberry jam, served with your choice from a selection of teas.
